description_en: Queries the list of aggregation task groups
kebab_example: aliyun cms list-agg-task-groups --instance-id rw-pq4apob9jm --filter-agg-task-group-ids '["aggTaskGroup-xxx"]' --filter-agg-task-group-names '["apiserver_request_total"]' --status Running --target-prometheus-id rw-pq4apob9jm --tags value=value1 key=key1 --max-results 20 --next-token 28036394xxx --query test --api-version 2024-03-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAggTaskGroups

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Managed Service for Prometheus instance to which the aggregation node group belongs. The aggregation node reads data from this instance
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组所属的 Prometheus 实例ID，聚合任务从这个实例中读取数据
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The list of aggregation task group IDs. The value must be a JSON-parsable string
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组的 id 列表，需要能被 JSON 解析
parameters.name: filter_agg_task_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of aggregation task group names. The value must be a JSON-parsable string
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组名称列表，需要能被 JSON 解析
parameters.name: filter_agg_task_group_names

parameters.help_en:
The status of the aggregation task group. Valid values:

Running
Stopped

Default value: Running
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组状态，“Running” 或者 “Stopped”。默认 Running
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the target Managed Service for Prometheus instance for the aggregation node group
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组的目标 Prometheus 实例ID
parameters.name: target_prometheus_id

fields.help_en: The key of the resource group tag
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the resource group tag
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The name to search for. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 名称搜索。支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: query
